Q1_TARGET_INFORMATIVENESS: Requires complete sample-level training delta_u and u_target for every authorized primary formal run.
Requires exact prospectively frozen aggregation rule; epoch summaries alone are insufficient.
Q2_SELECTOR_OPTIMIZATION: Requires optimization-step non-neutral-target count/fraction aligned with selector_gradient_norm.
Requires selector parameter movement from exact initialization.
Unconditional epoch gradient summaries are insufficient for the conditional gradient criterion.
Q3_SELECTOR_LEARNING_CALIBRATION: Requires paired target and utility_probability at sample level plus prospectively frozen calibration/discrimination statistics before formal decision exposure.
Q4_CONDITION_DISCRIMINATION: Requires frozen condition identities and per-seed condition utility summaries.
No post-exposure condition regrouping is permitted.
Q5_INTERVENTION_MAPPING: Requires utility probability, gate, active indicator and exact mapping parameters/thresholds frozen before formal training.
No post-exposure threshold search is permitted.
Q6_CLEAN_SAFEGUARD: Requires frozen comparator roster, seeds, clean metric, aggregation and margin before formal training.
adjudicability_rules.missingness_policy: If any required criterion evidence is absent at the required granularity, that criterion is NOT_ADJUDICABLE_FROM_FROZEN_EVIDENCE. Missingness must not be converted to NOT_SUPPORTED and may not be repaired by retraining after formal results are exposed.

not_frozen_yet: formal validation condition matrix if changed from inherited matrix
formal_decision_design_boundary.rule: Every not-yet-frozen item required for a formal decision must be frozen before formal training. No item may be selected after exposure to formal v0.34 results.

formal_mechanism_questions.Q1_TARGET_INFORMATIVENESS: Does the prospective counterfactual utility target contain sufficiently non-neutral, heterogeneous, condition-sensitive supervision?
formal_mechanism_questions.Q2_SELECTOR_OPTIMIZATION: Does the selector receive non-trivial gradient signal and exhibit measurable parameter movement when non-neutral supervision is present?
formal_mechanism_questions.Q3_SELECTOR_LEARNING_CALIBRATION: Does learned utility probability track the target and separate beneficial from harmful candidate intervention opportunities?
formal_mechanism_questions.Q4_CONDITION_DISCRIMINATION: Does learned utility order matched, degraded, mismatched, and catastrophic regimes in the intended direction?
formal_mechanism_questions.Q5_INTERVENTION_MAPPING: Conditional on informative learned utility, does the frozen intervention mapping activate selectively while retaining exact inactive/default behavior where intervention is not justified?
formal_mechanism_questions.Q6_CLEAN_SAFEGUARD: Does the successor retain the inherited clean-performance safeguard?

hard_pretraining_gates.pass_condition: A controlled engineering run writes every required sample-level, optimization-step, epoch-summary and validation field to machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts with stable schema.

Controlled evidence includes both positive and negative delta_u examples and at least one non-neutral target under the frozen abs(delta_u)>=0.01 definition, with exact p_ref_true/p_candidate_true/delta_u/u_target consistency checks.
At least one optimization step with non_neutral_target_count>0 has finite selector_gradient_norm>1e-8, finite utility loss>0, and selector_parameter_l2_update_this_step>1e-8.
Effective runtime loss weights are persisted and asserted against the later exact mechanism contract; CLI/config values alone are insufficient.
The later exact mechanism contract must include a controlled case proving that the inactive/default intervention path is exact, not merely numerically close.
A separate verifier can compute all planned formal mechanism statistics solely from persisted engineering artifacts without rerunning training or reconstructing missing sample/step evidence.

prospective_aggregation_rules.clean_performance: Macro-F1 on the prospectively frozen clean validation condition, aggregated by arithmetic mean across authorized seeds.
prospective_aggregation_rules.condition_utility: Arithmetic mean of sample-level utility_probability within each frozen seed-condition cell; cross-seed condition summaries are arithmetic means of the three seed-cell means unless a later pre-training protocol explicitly freezes another rule.
prospective_aggregation_rules.non_neutral_target_definition: abs(delta_u) >= 0.01. This definition is frozen for observability/adjudicability and may not be changed after formal training begins.
prospective_aggregation_rules.parameter_movement: L2 distance between current selector parameters and their exact initialized values for that formal run.
prospective_aggregation_rules.rounding: Full stored precision is used for formal comparisons; presentation rounding occurs only after decisions.
prospective_aggregation_rules.selector_gradient_population: Optimization steps with non_neutral_target_count > 0. Formal gradient summaries are computed only from those prospectively persisted steps.
prospective_aggregation_rules.target_signal_population: For formal target-signal adjudication, concatenate the prospectively persisted sample-level training records from all authorized primary formal runs. Each observed training sample occurrence is one observation. No averaging of epoch-level standard deviations is permitted as a substitute.

epoch_training_summary.purpose: Human-auditable summaries; sample/step artifacts remain authoritative for recomputable frozen aggregations.

optimization_step_training.purpose: Q2 and runtime-weight verification. Gradient evidence must be aligned to the same optimization step's target-neutrality evidence.

sample_level_training.purpose: Q1/Q3/Q5; permits exact distributional and conditional characterization without retrospective reconstruction.

validation_condition_summary.purpose: Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6 across the prospectively frozen validation condition matrix.

validation_sample_level_primary.purpose: Exact discrimination/calibration and condition-sensitive analyses for the primary successor.

scientific_objective: Prospectively distinguish target-signal informativeness, selector optimization/learning, utility discrimination/calibration, and intervention-mapping behavior without sacrificing the inherited clean-reference safeguard.
